caseName: California Dental Ass'n v. Federal Trade Commission
caseNameFull: California Dental Assn. v. Federal Trade Commission

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, November 10, 1998. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 8, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 29,1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
